name: rhany
description: Direct RunningHub standard-model calls by raw endpoint. Prefer payload.imageUrls HTTPS refs; files only under $DATA/$PLUGIN.

tools.name: rhany.run
tools.description: Submit a RunningHub model by raw endpoint (e.g. dola-Seedream-5.0-pro/image-to-image). Prefer payload.imageUrls as HTTPS links (runninghub.cn/view or prior download_url). resolution must be 1k or 2k when the model requires it. files paths are only under $DATA or the plugin folder — not project _inbox. On SUCCESS, always web.fetch_file urls[0] into the project; result URLs expire ~24h.
